I posted the draft bullets for the note to June as a reply in the #coastal-team thread, Sofia. Nothing has been sent to June.

The bullets cover the 16 Feb rename from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living, and the saved report that still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". They also note that the old label makes the receiving supervisor at the Mid-Atlantic cross-dock search twice. The "PHL" shorthand also turns up in port-logistics search results, which adds to the confusion.

Moss's digest is dated 18 May, so I can't tell whether the report label has been fixed since. It's worth confirming that before the note goes out.
